title: Mohenjo Daro
desc: Sarman, a poor farmer, arrives in Mohenjo Daro, a city ruled by the tyrant Maham. He learns about the history that his family shares with Maham and devises a plan to take revenge on him.

title: Betaab
desc: Love story of two youngsters who fall in love despite the status gaps between their families and must face the odds to stay together.

title: Student Of The Year
desc: Abhimanyu and Rohan's friendship is tested when they compete for a title and Abhimanyu falls for Rohan's girlfriend.

title: Chandni
desc: Chandni should choose between her paralysed fiance, Rohit, and her boss, Lalit, in Mumbai.

title: Humko Tumse Pyaar Hai
desc: A blind girl loses her lover just when she regains her sight and meets another man who falls in love with her. She accepts his proposal, but around the same time, her former lover returns.

title: Tere Naam
desc: Problems arise when a girl's parents oppose her marriage to a boy of her choice. At the same time, the boy loses his memory.

title: Band Baaja Baaraat
desc: Shruti and Bittoo launch Shaadi Mubarak, a wedding planning business. Their teamwork is strong, but Shruti falls for Bittoo, putting their professional partnership at risk.
